newsitem.title: USA: Applied Graphics files for 5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Applied Graphics files for 5 mln shares.

text.p: Applied Graphics Technologies Inc filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to five million common shares.
Of the shares to be issued, the company will sell three million shares and a group of shareholders will sell two million common shares.
Underwriters for the offering, Cowen & Co, Bear Stearns & Co Inc, Merrill Lynch & Co and Montgomery Securities, have an over-allotment option of up to 750,000 shares.
Applied Graphics said it will use the proceeds from the shares it sells to fund potential acquisitions, working capital needs and other corporate needs.
After the offering, the company will have 17,355,683 shares outstanding.
